title: BDL Basic Circular No. 167: Translation Principles of Foreign-Currency Denominated Assets and Liabilities into Lebanese Pound
text:
Basic Circular No. 167
To Banks and Financial Institutions
Attached is a copy of Basic Decision No. 13612 of 2 February 2024, on the Translation
Principles of Foreign-Currency Denominated Assets and Liabilities into Lebanese Pound.
Beirut, 2 February 2024
The Acting Governor of the Banque du Liban
Dr. Wassim Manssouri

Basic Decision No. 13612
Translation Principles of Foreign-Currency Denominated Assets and Liabilities
into Lebanese Pound
The Acting Governor of the Banque du Liban,
Pursuant to the Code of Money and Credit, particularly Articles 70, 146, and 174 thereof;
Pursuant to Law 28/67 of 9 May 1967 on amending and completing the banking legislation
and establishing the National Institute for the Guarantee of Deposits, particularly Article 3
thereof;
Pursuant to Decree 4665 of 26 December 1981 on Establishing a General Accounting Plan,
particularly Articles 2 and 22 thereof;
Pursuant to Decision 10/1/J issued by the Ministry of Finance on 9 April 1984 and relating
to the Accounting Plan of banks and financial institutions, particularly Annex 4
(assessment principles of transactions in foreign currencies) thereof;
In implementation of IFRS requirements;
Pursuant to the Decision of the Central Council of the Banque du Liban, taken in its
meeting of 2 February 2024;
Decides the following:
Article 1:
All banks and financial institutions are required, when preparing their financial positions, to take
into consideration the IAS21 principles, and to translate the accounts of foreign-currency
denominated monetary assets and liabilities, and non-monetary assets classified at fair value or
assessed as per the Equity Method, into their equivalent in Lebanese pound, at the exchange rate
applied on BDL electronic Exchange Platform on the date of the preparation of the financial
statements.
Article 2:
This Decision shall come into force as of the position closed on the 31st of January 2024.

Article 3:
This Decision shall be published in the Official Gazette.
Beirut, 2 February 2024
The Acting Governor of the Banque du Liban
Dr. Wassim Manssouri
